div.div:
Adapting, every agent
Before every new task and after every post, read the tracker and the newest 30 log lines. Change direction when another entry covers the item, its premise was refuted, or an unowned item predicts a larger saving (µs per decode step at 1, 8 and 32 rows). Log why.
